title: Non-protoplast Method for Generating Karyotypes of Zymoseptoria tritici
author: Martina

steps.title: Culture Zymoseptoria tritici
steps.instruction: Inoculate YMA plates or YSB solution with Zt and incubate at 18°C for 4 to 6 days, ensuring the use of young (log) cultures.

steps.title: Harvest and concentrate spores
steps.instruction: Collect spores from the culture and concentrate them into a pellet.

substeps.instruction: Add 3-5 mL of sterile TE Buffer or sterile water per plate to harvest spores and transfer to a 50 mL Falcon tube.
Add TE Buffer or water up to the 45 mL mark.
Gently shake the tube and filter through a nylon mesh (Miracloth) or 1-2 layers of cheesecloth into a new 50 mL Falcon tube (skip if spores are very fine).
Centrifuge at 3500 rpm for 5-15 min at room temperature.
Pour off supernatant (expected pellet volume: 500 to 750 ul).
Optionally resuspend to 45 mL of TE Buffer or water and repeat centrifugation.

steps.title: Prepare and count spore suspension
steps.instruction: Resuspend the spore pellet and determine the concentration.

substeps.instruction: Add 1-2 mL (or more) of TE Buffer (do not use water) to the tube and dissolve the pellet by vortexing.
Dilute the spores (1:100 or more) and count using a Thoma chamber (expected concentration: 10^8 to 10^9 spores/mL).

steps.title: Cast agarose plugs
steps.instruction: Embed spores in low melting agarose (LMA) to create plugs.

substeps.instruction: Pre-warm diluted spores and 2% LMA (molten at 55°C) in a water bath.
Mix equal volumes of spores and LMA (e.g., 1.5 mL of diluted spores with 1.5 mL of LMA) to achieve a final concentration of 1 to 5 x 10^8 spores.
Cast the mixture into a plug-casting apparatus previously cooled on ice.

steps.title: Incubate and treat plugs
steps.instruction: Treat the plugs with EDTA, SDS, and protease to prepare for karyotyping.

substeps.instruction: Incubate plugs in 5 mL of 0.45 M EDTA (pH 8) buffer containing 1% SDS and 1 mg/mL protease (type XIV, Sigma P5147) at 60°C for 48h.
Change the incubation buffer and enzyme after the first 24 h.
Rinse plugs 2 to 3 times with 6 mL (or more) of 0.5 M EDTA (pH 8.0).
Store plugs in 0.5 M EDTA (pH 8.0) at 4°C.
